edges.reason: Constructor assigns the caller-controlled msg.sender to the admin state variable, granting admin authority.
Constructor assigns msg.sender to governance, which controls implementation and market parameters.
Constructor calls the internal delegateTo helper to run the initialize function on the implementation.
_setImplementation requires msg.sender == governance before replacing the implementation.
_setImplementation writes the new implementation address into the implementation state variable.
Parameter implementation_ flows into the implementation state variable.
_setAdmin requires msg.sender == admin before transferring the admin role.
_setAdmin updates the admin state variable with newAdmin.
Parameter newAdmin flows into the admin state variable.
_setGovernance requires msg.sender == governance before transferring governance.
_setGovernance updates the governance state variable with newGovernance.
Parameter newGovernance flows into the governance state variable.
delegateTo passes its arguments into the low-level delegatecall operation.
Parameter callee is used as the delegatecall target.
Parameter data is used as the delegatecall calldata.
delegateTo branches into the assembly revert when the delegatecall fails.
Local success flag drives the assembly failure check.
Local returnData is bubbled up in the assembly revert.
Fallback performs an external delegatecall to the implementation with arbitrary msg.data, which can re-enter the delegator storage context.
The fallback delegatecall target is read from the implementation state variable.
Fallback uses inline assembly to switch on success and return or revert the raw returndata.

normalization_plan.reason: _WETH is only used inside the constructor call to initialize; it has no independent identity.
_governance is only used inside the constructor call to initialize.
implementation_ is only used inside the constructor to set the implementation.
implementation_ is the direct input written by _setImplementation.
newAdmin is the direct input written by _setAdmin into admin.
newGovernance is the direct input written by _setGovernance into governance.
callee is used only as the delegatecall target inside delegateTo.
data is used only as the delegatecall calldata inside delegateTo.
success is the result flag of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
returnData is the raw output of the delegatecall unsafe operation.
